metadata.title: SailTrue | Business & Web Intelligence
metadata.description: SailTrue diagnoses websites, optimizes SEO and GEO, integrates automation and AI, and builds custom apps and tools that help businesses scale.

hero.headlineAria: From diagnosis to scale — SEO, automation, and custom tools
hero.subtitle: We analyze websites, optimize discovery through SEO and GEO, integrate AI and automation, and build custom apps that help your business grow.

problem.title: Growth breaks in systems, not slogans.
problem.description: Websites underperform when signals, workflows, and tooling fall out of sync. Without structured diagnosis and the right build capacity, SEO gains, automation, and scale never compound.

signals.title: Trust Gaps
signals.note: Credibility signals fall below category norms

signals.title: Conversion Leakage
signals.note: Decision flow breaks at key moments

signals.title: Discovery Gaps
signals.note: SEO and GEO signals miss high-intent demand

signals.title: Manual Drag
signals.note: Repetitive ops block teams from scaling

methodology.title: Measure first. Decide second. Improve continuously.
methodology.description: We establish evidence before direction — then optimize, automate, and build what the business needs to scale.

steps.title: Detect
steps.body: We audit websites, SEO/GEO visibility, UX clarity, trust signals, and conversion flow to establish a real baseline.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.body: We rank interventions — optimization, automation, or custom build — by business impact, effort, and urgency.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: We execute improvements, integrate AI where it compounds value, and ship custom tools that remove friction at scale.

signalLayers.title: Performance is a system of signals.
signalLayers.description: SailTrue evaluates each layer independently and systemically — from search and generative engine visibility to UX, trust, and conversion.
signalLayers.detailBody: Weak links in {layer} produce compounding drag across trust, interpretation speed, and conversion quality. We resolve it with measurable interventions and continuous verification.
signalLayers.detailMetric: Scored by friction risk · revenue influence · layer dependency

transformation.title: Diagnosis is the start. Scale is the system.
transformation.description: We partner with businesses on the full stack — from website intelligence to SEO, automation, AI, and custom product builds.

paths.title: Website diagnosis & optimization
paths.body: Structured audits across technical health, UX clarity, trust, and conversion — with continuous verification as you grow.

paths.title: SEO & GEO
paths.body: Search and generative engine visibility engineered for real demand — technical foundations, content signals, and measurable ranking gains.

paths.title: Automation & AI integration
paths.body: Workflows, agents, and intelligent systems that remove manual drag and compound operational leverage.

paths.title: Custom apps & internal tools
paths.body: Purpose-built software — dashboards, client portals, and ops tools — designed to help your business scale without friction.

proof.title: Evidence over claims.
proof.description: High-performing businesses combine structured diagnosis, SEO and GEO discipline, smart automation, and tools built for how they actually operate.

process.title: Clear rhythm. Clear ownership. Clear progress.
process.description: A disciplined model from baseline insight through optimization, automation, and custom build delivery.

steps.label: Onboard
steps.body: Align on business model, growth priorities, and where diagnosis, SEO, automation, or build fits.

steps.label: Baseline
steps.body: Build a cross-layer view of website performance, discovery signals, and operational bottlenecks.

steps.label: Deliver
steps.body: Execute SEO/GEO, automation, AI integration, or custom tools — with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.

steps.label: Iterate
steps.body: Recalibrate based on results and continue compounding gains as the business scales.

finalCta.title: Tell us where you want to scale.
finalCta.body: Share your website, growth objective, and what you need — diagnosis, SEO/GEO, automation, AI, or a custom build. We will return a focused direction and practical next steps.

metadata.title: Services | SailTrue
metadata.description: Website diagnosis, SEO and GEO, automation and AI integration, and custom apps — built to help businesses scale.

hero.title: We build growth systems, not slide decks.
hero.body: Diagnosis, SEO, automation, AI, and custom tools — delivered with the same rigor agencies reserve for strategy decks. Outcomes you can measure.

philosophy.title: You hire us for outcomes. Everything else is how we deliver.
philosophy.paragraph1: Services generate results — and that's what you pay for.
philosophy.paragraph2: Structured diagnosis, messaging clarity, technical audits, and build discipline — we don't invoice these as line items. They're how we make the services work.
philosophy.paragraph3: When we optimize your SEO, automate a workflow, or ship a custom tool, it's backed by evidence — not assumptions.

services.title: Four capabilities. One growth system.
services.description: Each service stands alone or compounds with the others — from first diagnosis to custom infrastructure.

items.title: Website diagnosis & optimization
items.body: Structured audits across technical health, UX clarity, trust signals, and conversion — with continuous verification as you grow.

items.title: SEO & GEO
items.body: Search and generative engine visibility engineered for real demand — not vanity rankings.

items.title: Automation & AI integration
items.body: Workflows and intelligent systems that remove manual drag and compound operational leverage.

items.title: Custom apps & internal tools
items.body: Purpose-built software — dashboards, portals, and ops tools — designed for how your business actually scales.

steps.label: Deep dive
steps.title: Understand the business better than the brief
steps.body: We map your model, technology, market, and bottlenecks — website signals, discovery gaps, manual ops, and build requirements. Then we define storylines for what to fix, automate, or build first.

steps.label: Build & optimize
steps.title: Execute with evidence behind every decision
steps.body: SEO and GEO improvements, UX fixes, automation flows, AI integrations, or custom apps — prioritized by impact and shipped with clear ownership.

steps.label: Amplify
steps.title: Deploy, integrate, and make it stick
steps.body: We don't ship and disappear. Tools get integrated into daily ops, teams get clarity, and every deliverable is positioned to keep generating value.

steps.label: Compound
steps.title: Measure, iterate, and expand what works
steps.body: New storylines, new optimizations, new automations — we recalibrate based on outcomes and keep compounding gains as the business scales.

outcomes.title: Evidence over claims.
